d2_relevance_aggregation_rule.rule: Deterministic case-level D2-relevance aggregation: consider only system-failed structurally valid groups (successful groups and the structurally impossible n023.e1 carry no relevance). case_d2_relevance = DIRECT if at least one such group is DIRECT; else INDIRECT if at least one is INDIRECT; else NONE. Applied mechanically to all 28 cases.
